stories.title: Plastic packaging market projected to reach $668.9 billion by 2034
stories.summary: The global plastic packaging market was valued at $428.6 billion in 2025 and is set to grow at a 5.1% CAGR through 2034, according to Prismane Consulting. The industry cites versatility and lightweight properties as primary drivers for its continued role in modern supply chains.

stories.title: Thermocol packaging market sees growth from electronics and pharma demand
stories.summary: The thermocol packaging market is expanding as industries prioritize lightweight, durable, and protective solutions. The material remains a preferred choice for electronics and pharmaceutical sectors seeking specific physical properties. The market continues to explore emerging trends and segments to maintain its current growth trajectory.

stories.title: Single-use packaging market set to grow 8.7% in 2026
stories.summary: The single-use packaging market is projected to grow from $35.44 billion in 2025 to $38.53 billion in 2026. Industry analysts attribute this expansion to shifts in consumer behavior and a rising demand for convenient, disposable packaging solutions across various sectors.

stories.title: PCR plastic packaging market projected to grow at 6.6% CAGR
stories.summary: The market for post-consumer recycled plastic packaging is projected to increase from $54.73 billion in 2025 to $5 billion by 2030, according to industry forecasts. Companies and consumers are increasingly seeking environmentally friendly solutions to address rising awareness regarding plastic waste and sustainability.

stories.title: Flexible plastic packaging market shows strong momentum
stories.summary: The flexible plastic packaging industry grew from $180.16 billion in 2025, driven by evolving consumer habits and technological advancements. As demand for efficient and sustainable packaging solutions rises, the market is positioned for further expansion across its various global applications.

stories.title: Flexible plastic packaging market expected to reach $283.1 billion by 2034
stories.summary: Prismane Consulting reports the global flexible plastic packaging market was valued at $174.8 billion in 2025. It is set to grow at a 5.5% CAGR through 2034, supported by consistent demand for lightweight and cost-efficient packaging solutions within the global supply chain.

stories.title: Study finds biodegradable plastic struggles in landfill conditions
stories.summary: Researchers from South Korea tested three biodegradable plastics in simulated landfill conditions over 320 days. The study found that polybutylene adipate terephthalate reached minimal breakdown levels when deprived of oxygen, raising questions about the real-world performance of materials marketed as biodegradable in landfill environments.

stories.title: Flexible packaging market projected to expand at 7.6% CAGR
stories.summary: The flexible packaging sector is expected to increase from $308.11 billion in 2025 to $331.79 billion by 2030. Industry growth is attributed to evolving consumer preferences and ongoing advances in material technologies that prioritize convenience and efficiency.

EU launches safeguard investigation into PET resin imports
stories.summary: The European Union has launched a safeguard investigation into imports of virgin and recycled PET resin, along with associated feedstocks. Imports rose to 2.70 million tonnes as the region reports a loss of recycling capacity since 2023, according to Recycling International.

stories.title: Italian waste paper exports to India rise
stories.summary: Italy exported nearly 950,000 tonnes of waste paper in the first half of 2026, a 13% increase over the previous year. India received 44.8% of the total volume, establishing itself as a primary destination for the material as European businesses navigate high energy and transport costs.

stories.title: Polyethylene lamination films market projected to grow at 6.2% CAGR
stories.summary: The polyethylene lamination films market is expected to grow from its 2025 valuation of $1.45 billion. Industry reports link this expansion to evolving consumer behavior and packaging technology, as demand for flexible and protective solutions continues to rise.

stories.title: Plastic recycling market expands alongside plastic use
stories.summary: The plastic recycling sector is projected to grow from a $48.0 billion valuation as global efforts to manage waste intensify. The industry is currently focused on the adoption of new recycling technologies to address environmental concerns linked to increasing plastic consumption.

stories.title: PLA-based bioplastics gain traction in packaging
stories.summary: The plastic industry continues to grow, with a focus on integrating sustainable options like PLA-based bioplastics. The sector is currently evolving to include these materials as part of a broader strategy to address environmental impacts while maintaining steady industry expansion through 2030.

stories.title: Low-density polyethylene packaging market projected to grow at 6.8% CAGR
stories.summary: The low-density polyethylene packaging market is forecast to grow through 2035, according to The Business Research Company. The material is gaining attention for its versatility and efficiency, driven by changing consumer preferences and evolving demands within the global packaging industry.

stories.title: What It Takes to Make Packaging Recycling Work - Packaging World
Bath researchers secure £1.7 million for acrylic recycling
stories.summary: Researchers at the University of Bath secured a £1.7 million grant from the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council and Defra. The funding aims to advance technologies for recycling acrylic plastics and strengthen national capacity to recover difficult materials. The academic team will now conduct a multidisciplinary research programme.

stories.title: Lessons from Washington’s PCR law, 3 years into enforcement - Packaging Dive
Indian recycler expands bottle-to-bottle capacity
stories.summary: RiBotl Solutions has commissioned a Starlinger recoSTAR PET 165 system in Silvassa. The facility, which began operations in early 2025, has the capacity to produce 16,000 metric tonnes of bottle-grade rPET pellets annually. The company claims the technology produces EFSA and US FDA compliant recycled chips.

stories.title: RERF awards 2026 veteran education stipends
stories.summary: The Recycling Education and Research Foundation has named the recipients of its 2026 stipends. The programme provides $2,500 to veterans for formal training or living expenses. Since 2002, the foundation has awarded nearly $1 million in aid to more than 700 students to promote recycling education.

stories.title: Japan considers mandatory recycled content targets
stories.summary: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry is considering setting numerical targets for recycled plastic use in PET bottles. The secretariat noted that relying on market forces alone risks failing to develop domestic supply and demand. Policy directions are expected to be outlined within fiscal year 2026.

stories.title: Nigeria introduces new plastic waste regulations
stories.summary: The National Environmental Plastic Waste Control Regulations 2026 place new obligations on producers, importers, and converters in Nigeria. The rules require registration with producer responsibility organisations. The government notes that packaging choices directly impact the cost of goods and the price of products on the shelf.

stories.title: Government departments miss recycling targets
stories.summary: Government departments generated 158,041 tonnes of waste between April 2024 and March 2025, a 16 percent reduction against the 2017 baseline. While the waste reduction target was exceeded, only six of 23 departments achieved recycling rates of at least 70 percent. The target was 70 percent.

stories.title: Packaging industry calls for EPR tax review
stories.summary: The Packaging Federation has requested an independent review of the EPR packaging tax, citing a need to avoid constant crises. The call follows a government decision to slash glass tax fees by 40 percent to support the hospitality sector. The industry warns that shifting costs is not sustainable.

stories.title: Mumbai partners with The Ocean Cleanup
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation has signed an agreement with The Ocean Cleanup to deploy interceptor systems in local waterways. The initiative aims to prevent plastic debris from entering the Arabian Sea. The project follows successful barrier trials at Trombay Creek and Malad Creek in the city.

stories.title: Industry warns of regulatory uncertainty
stories.summary: Constantia Flexibles, LYB, and Syndigo report that fragmented requirements and slow technological development are complicating packaging redesigns. Industry experts are calling for harmonized regulations that balance circularity goals with product protection and affordability. They argue that current uncertainty is actively slowing down circular innovation across the sector.

stories.title: Clean Recycle launches PPWR compliance platform
stories.summary: Clean Recycle has launched a digital platform to assist companies with European PPWR regulation compliance. The tool helps manufacturers assess packaging against requirements for material composition, weight reduction, and recyclability. The regulation extends obligations across the entire life cycle of packaging from design to final waste management.

stories.title: Textile waste continues to grow
stories.summary: Former UN Secretary-General António Guterres noted that the global fashion industry sends the equivalent of one garbage truck of clothing to landfill or incineration every second. The industry is currently exploring whether extended producer responsibility and textile-to-textile recycling can address the rising volume of discarded clothing.

stories.title: Government to exempt glass from pEPR fees
stories.summary: From April 2027, most glass drink containers supplied to hospitality venues will be exempt from pEPR disposal fees. The government aims to resolve concerns over double-charging for packaging. The Packaging Federation welcomed the move, noting that producer fees can have unintended consequences for manufacturers and the hospitality sector.

stories.title: Frugalpac warns against glass fee exemptions
stories.summary: Frugalpac CEO Malcolm Waugh warned that exempting glass from pEPR fees could disadvantage alternative packaging formats. The government plans to examine future fee modulation based on recyclability. Waugh stated that the government must not confuse making glass cheaper with the goal of making drinks packaging greener.

stories.title: Food industry demand boosts chipboard market
stories.summary: The recycled white lined chipboard market is seeing growth driven by food and beverage industry demand. Sustainability and cost-effectiveness are cited as primary factors for the shift toward eco-friendly packaging. The market is currently undergoing expansion as consumer preferences continue to favor recycled material options.

stories.title: Flexible packaging paper market projected to reach $116.7 billion by 2036
stories.summary: The global flexible packaging paper market is valued at $78.90 billion in 2026, according to Future Market Insights. The industry is projected to reach $116.70 billion by 2036, growing at a 4.0% annual rate. Food manufacturers are driving demand for paper that combines protection and recycling compatibility.

stories.title: Paper and paperboard packaging market growth outlook
stories.summary: The paper and paperboard packaging market is projected to reach $546.52 billion by 2030. Demand is driven by evolving consumer preferences and the expansion of industries relying on sustainable materials. The sector is positioning itself for ongoing expansion as environmental concerns intensify and e-commerce continues to surge.

stories.title: Machine glazed kraft paper market set for steady growth
stories.summary: The global machine glazed kraft paper market was valued at $11.4 billion in 2025 and is expected to reach $17.6 billion by 2034. Prismane Consulting reports a projected annual growth rate of 4.9% as manufacturers increasingly adopt paper-based packaging materials to meet sustainability goals.

stories.title: Paper tray box market expands amid global pivot from plastic
stories.summary: The global paper tray box market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more regionally diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. Growth is driven by the global pivot away from plastic, stringent regulatory frameworks, and the continued expansion of e-commerce and sustainable packaging solutions.

stories.title: Life Water launches paper-based bottle
stories.summary: British brand Life Water has unveiled a paper-based water bottle developed with Pulpex. The 500ml product uses moulded-fibre technology to transform wood fibre into a bottle designed for existing paper recycling streams. The company aims to challenge conventional formats and reduce the environmental impact of packaged water.

stories.title: Pulpex secures £19.6 million investment for Glasgow facility
stories.summary: The National Wealth Fund has invested £19.6 million in Pulpex to support its new Glasgow manufacturing facility. The funding, which includes additional co-investment from the Scottish National Investment Bank, is intended to accelerate the deployment of the company's fibre bottle technology through its global licensing network.

stories.title: Folding carton packaging market forecast to reach $239 billion by 2036
stories.summary: The global folding carton packaging market is forecast to increase from $153.9 billion in 2026 to $239.0 billion by 2036, according to Fact.MR. The industry is expanding at a 4.5% annual rate, with India leading at 5.8% and Germany recording 3.6% growth.

stories.title: Andritz to host sustainable packaging event
stories.summary: Andritz will host its Sustainable Packaging Days 2027 on March 18 to 19, 2027, at the company's facility in Montbonnot, France. The event will focus on showcasing cellulose-based pathways for the packaging industry.

stories.title: Maxcess deepens investment in India
stories.summary: Maxcess International is increasing its investment in India as local converting and packaging equipment makers gain a competitive edge. The US-based company, which has operated in the country for 25 years, showcased its portfolio at the Loupe India 2026 exhibition.

stories.title: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries celebrates 70 years of paper converting
stories.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Machinery Systems held a ceremony in Tokyo to mark the 70th anniversary of its paper converting division. Since 1956, the company has delivered more than 300 corrugating machines and over 700 box-making machines to customers globally.

stories.title: Atlantic Zeiser introduces automated card packaging system
stories.summary: Atlantic Zeiser will introduce its COBOMASTER system at TRUSTECH 2026 in Paris. Designed for card service bureaus, the machine automates the transition from personalized cards to finished packages, aiming to eliminate manual insertion bottlenecks for premium payment and gift cards.

stories.title: Industrial knife blades market linked to manufacturing output
stories.summary: The global industrial knife blades market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior, according to IndexBox. The sector remains essential for converting raw materials into finished goods, with demand intrinsically linked to global industrial output and capital investment cycles.

stories.title: Folding carton machinery market enters expansion phase
stories.summary: The global folding carton making machines market is projected to accelerate through 2035, according to IndexBox. This capital equipment segment is being reshaped by the packaging industry's shift toward sustainability, automation, and digitalization as converters seek to reduce waste and improve efficiency.

stories.title: Moksha reports 13 machines in order book
stories.summary: Moksha Label Printing reported nine deliveries of its new flexographic press through 31 October 2026, with 13 additional machines in its order book. The press is designed to process substrates ranging from 12-micron films to 300 GSM paperboard for the label and packaging segments.

stories.title: Independent cart technology offers packaging flexibility
stories.summary: Independent cart technology is changing packaging machine design by allowing systems to adapt to different product formats without manual adjustments. The technology replaces traditional belts and mechanical feeders, enabling machines to maintain spacing and deliver items to operations with greater flexibility.

stories.title: Serialised packaging and the shift to 2D barcodes - Packaging Gateway
Smart packaging market growth
stories.summary: The smart packaging industry is expanding, driven by evolving consumer demands and technological advancements. The market is currently shaped by innovations in materials and the integration of digital technologies. The industry continues to explore its own trajectory, including market size, key drivers, and emerging trends.

stories.title: E-commerce packaging market to reach US$360.6 billion by 2033
stories.summary: The global e-commerce packaging sector is projected to reach US$121.6 billion by 2026, escalating to US$360.6 billion by 2033. Persistence Market Research attributes this 16.8% compound annual growth rate to the expansion of online retail and cross-border shipping volumes. The market is expected to grow significantly.

stories.title: Plastic spice jars market enters 2026
stories.summary: The global plastic spice jars market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture. This mature category, defined by rigid containers made from PET, PP, PS, or HDPE, remains tied to the steady replenishment cycles of pantry staples and food retail.

stories.title: How connected packaging is creating a new digital channel for brands - Packaging Gateway
Airline amenity kit packaging market forecast at USD 3.6 billion
stories.summary: The global airline amenity kit disposable packaging market is valued at USD 1.11 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD 3.57 billion by 2036. Future Market Insights anticipates a 12.4% compound annual growth rate, driven by premium cabin service upgrades and changing sustainability expectations.

stories.title: Target links food growth to packaging
stories.summary: At the Private Label Manufacturers Association event, Target’s food chief identified packaging as a primary driver for the retailer's growth. The company is placing its packaging strategies at the center of its food business development.

stories.title: Corrugated handle box market analysis
stories.summary: The corrugated handle box market is experiencing growth, attributed to expanding retail channels and demand for efficient packaging solutions. Businesses are prioritizing sustainable and customizable options as the sector continues to develop. The market is currently exploring its own key drivers and segmentation insights.

stories.title: LEAP India acquires two packaging businesses for ₹142 crore
stories.summary: LEAP India will acquire Vimprotech and Total International Packaging Solutions for a combined ₹142 crore. The pallet-pooling firm intends to transition from a pure-play leader into an integrated, end-to-end returnable packaging solutions provider. The transactions are expected to close by the third quarter of fiscal 2026-27.

stories.title: DCGpac revenue grows 35 percent in fiscal 2026
stories.summary: DCGpac reported a 34.6% year-on-year revenue increase to Rs 208.5 crore for the fiscal year ended March 2026. The company remains EBITDA positive, citing growing demand for customised and sustainable packaging solutions from e-commerce and direct-to-consumer brands looking to improve logistics and product presentation.

stories.title: Recove Ventures raises Rs 56.25 crore
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based plastic recycling startup Recove Ventures has raised Rs 56.25 crore in equity and debt to build infrastructure in Maharashtra and Karnataka. Investors include Sumeet Narang of Samara Capital and the family office of Chaitanya Kejriwal of Parkson's Packaging. Equity accounts for 64% of the total.

stories.title: Recove Ventures secures funding for circular economy infrastructure
stories.summary: Recove Ventures has raised Rs 56.25 crore through equity and debt to build supply chain infrastructure for India’s plastic recycling industry. Participants include Sumeet Narang, Capri Global, and existing investors such as the family office of Chaitanya Kejriwal. The capital is designated for circular economy infrastructure development.

stories.title: Recove Ventures targets plastic quality
stories.summary: Recove Ventures has raised ₹56.25 crore to expand recycling infrastructure in Maharashtra and Karnataka. Co-founder Viral Chhajer stated that the company is addressing a quality problem rather than a recycling problem. The funding consists of ₹36.25 crore in equity and ₹20 crore in debt.

stories.title: Recove raises $5.97M to scale India's plastic recycling network - Dealroom
Recove Ventures plans ₹2,000 crore infrastructure investment
stories.summary: Recove Ventures has raised ₹56.25 crore to support its expansion in Maharashtra and Karnataka. The company plans to invest over ₹2,000 crore across four states over the next decade. The current round includes participation from Sumeet Narang, Capri Global, and the family office of Chaitanya Kejriwal.

stories.title: Recove Ventures raises ₹56.25 crore for state expansion
stories.summary: Recove Ventures has raised ₹56.25 crore in equity and debt to expand recycling infrastructure across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Uttar Pradesh. The company has announced plans to invest over ₹2,000 crore in the coming decade. Investors include Sumeet Narang and the family office of Chaitanya Kejriwal.

stories.title: TCPL Packaging eyes lithium battery separator market
stories.summary: TCPL Packaging is entering the lithium-ion battery separator film business, moving away from its traditional focus on paperboard and flexible packaging. The company plans a phased approach, starting with coating before attempting to manufacture films to reduce reliance on imports from China.
